scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html styles.css app.js icon.svg manifest.webmanifest www/ && esbuild native-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=www/native.js && sed -i "s#<script src=\"app.js\"></script>#<script src=\"native.js\"></script><script src=\"app.js\"></script>#" www/index.html
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
